# ToolCompare

> Independent comparisons of SaaS and software tools: pricing, ease of use,
> feature depth, pros and cons. No vendor pays for placement.

ToolCompare tracks software tools and publishes side-by-side comparisons,
category rankings and alternative lists. Every ranking comes from our own
scores, not from paid placement.

## How to read our data

- Prices are the published starting price where we could verify one.
  Tools with usage-based pricing (for example Stripe or AWS) or with a free
  tier are marked as such and are deliberately excluded from "cheapest"
  claims rather than being shown as $0.
- Scores ("ease of use", "feature depth") are our own editorial scores.
  They are not vendor-supplied and not independently audited.
- We do not publish star ratings or review counts, because we do not
  collect them.

## Main sections

- /: full directory of tracked tools
- /categories: tools grouped by category, ranked
- /compare/<tool-a>-vs-<tool-b>: side-by-side comparison of two tools
- /alternatives/<tool>: ranked alternatives to a tool
- /tools/<tool>: full review of a single tool
- /top-picks: highest-scoring tools across the whole directory
- /terms: how we make money
